scope: BR-029 source/input and saved-mechanics audit; no fitting, model trial or clinical adjudication

retained_export.interpretation: Existing source-pinned material export checked; no new fitting or portable source distribution.

numerical_recovery.limit: Linear convergence does not prove full nonlinear stationarity.

superseded_axis_correction: All seven analyzed point arrays are unchanged. Three positive-AHA cells had -100 percent reference-frame engineering strain in superseded outputs from undefined axes; corrected outputs mark them NaN and exclude them only from directional statistics.
limits: One healthy simulation reconstructed; LBBB is reference playback only. No independent agent trial or observed patient strain.
Healthy controls are endpoint-only comparisons: privileged known-correspondence fits and video fits have different information. Tissue method is development-informed.
Source separation was reviewed in code, not enforced by an isolated provider runtime.
Directional mechanics covers 31241 of 31244 positive-AHA tetrahedra; all 47186 remain in geometry/Jacobian checks.
Physical frame duration is unknown. Tissue volume is not cavity volume or EF; this audit does not establish strain rate, flow, force balance or diagnosis.
Source redistribution terms remain unresolved. Native and derived image/mesh assets stay local.
review_kind: source, public-package and saved-mechanics audit; explainer visual acceptance remains pending

audit_implementation.repeat_check: Final two fresh audits have identical full replayed scores and native input contact sheets. Final audit adds regional point RMSE and full export labels/boundary checks.
audit_implementation.preliminary_observations: First audit stopped on a nested-list comparison bug in this new checker; corrected. A NumPy matmul warning in pose checking was eliminated by explicit float64 einsum, with finite matching pose values. Failed/preliminary logs are retained locally; no source defect or new model outcome is inferred.

visual_inspection.inputs: Native 192 x 192 public planes at frames 1 and 17, all four views; field of view and brighter/darker tissue pattern change are visible. These are resampled source images, not a model segmentation.
visual_inspection.source_anatomy: Retained anatomy-audit.png inspected: biventricular reference surface with red AHA 1-17 and blue AHA 0; regional assignment follows the source, not clinical adjudication.
visual_inspection.result_and_reference: Retained dynamic-heart-summary.png inspected: same frame-11 radial-strain range (-10 to 60 percent), known simulator geometry versus tissue-fit geometry, grey RV/unassigned surfaces, separate directional-MAE bars and myocardial tissue-volume curves. The tissue-fit surface has visibly different local strain distribution. Element/nodal fields and curve values underlying these views were reproduced.
visual_inspection.coverage: Selected stills and one historical result/reference figure, not full-cycle motion, integrated Explorer, mobile or no-GPU acceptance.
